trees.value_for_us: MOST COMPLETE public mainline effort for Kirin 659 (hi6250). SoC dtsi arch/arm64/boot/dts/hisilicon/hi6250.dtsi has PSCI/GIC/timer/PMU/hi6250-{ao,pmu,sys,crg}ctrl clocks/mailbox/reset/gpio25/pinctrl-single/PL011 uart0-6/dwmmc1 SD/dwmmc2 SDIO and full USB: usb_ahbif syscon + custom phy (drivers/phy/hisilicon/phy-hi6250-usb.c, compatible hisilicon,hi6250-usb-phy) + usb@ff100000 compatible "hisilicon,hi6220-usb","snps,dwc2" dr_mode=peripheral with explicit g-*-fifo-size. dwc2 node is disabled in dtsi but enabled (&usb status=ok) in hi6250-huawei-agassi2.dts (MediaPad T5, same Kirin 659). No anne/figo dts exists yet for ANE; we would add hi6250-huawei-anne.dts here.

trees.notes: SoC page; lists anne (P20 Lite) as 'Booting: Yes' only via downstream 4.9.148 pmOS port (Nura wiki Huawei_P20_Lite_(huawei-anne)).
trees.value_for_us: Upstream effort hub: mainlining happens on hi6250-mainline/linux + tildeknown/linux-hi6250 (matrix #hi6250-dev). Known-working mainline configs ship in hi6250-mainline/linux arch/arm64/configs/hi6250_defconfig: CONFIG_USB_DWC2=y, CONFIG_USB_DWC2_PERIPHERAL=y, CONFIG_USB_CONFIGFS=m with RNDIS/NCM/F_FS, CONFIG_PHY_HI6250_USB=y, PHY_HI6220_USB=y, NOP_USB_XCEIV=y, EXTCON_USB_GPIO=y — that is the DWC2-gadget recipe to copy for hi6250; it matches upstream dwc2 which has dwc2_set_his_params for "hisilicon,hi6220-usb" (drivers/usb/dwc2/params.c). USB networking itself is still 'Untested' on pmOS figo/agassi2 pages, so treat as present-but-unproven.

trees.notes: Experimental forks (branches 7.0-usb/7.0-dwmmc/7.0-reboot/hi6250-next); phy-hi6250-usb.c authored by Tildeguy 2026. Homepage: pmos wiki User:Tildeguy/Hi6250_Notes.
trees.value_for_us: Second mainline tree with the same hi6250.dtsi + dwc2 node + custom hi6250 USB PHY driver; 7.0-usb branch is where the USB/PHY work is landing before it lands in hi6250-mainline/linux. Wiki mainlining table: USB = 'hisilicon,hi6220-usb' P (written, untested/broken - 'no regulators'), USB phy = Y, everything else Y except I2C/reset/PMIC/GPU/UART/DMA/eMMC/SD/SDIO which are N/P. No anne dts here either.

trees.value_for_us: Reference for the hi1102 (Hi1102A) WiFi/BT firmware-loading path on EMUI 9 (this is the tree LineageOS 17-20 for anne builds from, with device trees hisi-oss/android_device_huawei_anne + hi6250-9-common): driver = drivers/connectivity/hi11xx/hi1102a (CONFIG_HI1102_PLATFORM=y CONFIG_HI1102_WIFI=y in merge_hi6250_defconfig -> built into the kernel, obj-y; obj-m plumbing exists but is off; a 'plat'/'wifi' .ko is only produced via the separate CONFIG_HI110X_KERNEL_MODULES_BUILD_SUPPORT=out-of-tree flow). Firmware is loaded by platform/pm/plat_firmware.c which kernel_reads text config files from /vendor/firmware/{bfgx_and_wifi_cfg,wifi_cfg,bfgx_cfg,ram_reg_test_cfg} and pushes the patch over SDIO (wifi) and UART /dev/ttyAMA3 (bfgx=BT/GPS/NFC per hisi_connectivity.dtsi hi1102 node: power gpio4.3, wlan-wake gpio26.5, bfgx-wake gpio26.2); no request_firmware, no /lib/firmware. Blobs come from vendor: hisi-oss/android_device_huawei_hi6250-9-common proprietary-files.txt lists vendor/firmware/bfgx_and_wifi_cfg, bfgx_cfg, wifi_cfg + gps.hi1102.default.so + vendor/bin/start_connectivity_hisi. No mainline/out-of-tree hi110x port of this driver exists anywhere (searched GitHub; 'hsak' mainline driver does not exist publicly).
